_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score anchored at Hope by F&G 63 with flat 30d momentum and offsetting flow extremes; coil base-rate favors HOLD until a named breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit Hope/HOLD; narrative silent on phase but skew tone is defensive/cautious, not opposed to HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound, 30d momentum near 50, fear_greed holds 55-70, and put skew does not keep expanding with price rollover
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks under 55 with extreme netflow and price rolling over, or momentum_30d lifts above 70 with ETF flows turning positive
